content:
[Refrain - open]
@voice bm_george
(break 2)
Body, edge and air, all in tune,
Shape the tone and get it right.

[Verse 1 - body]
@voice am_michael
(slot 2)
I'm boomy, I'm the rumble,
All chest, a heavy tumble,
Seven over, bloated,
Each vowel overloaded.
A blanket on the speaker,
The consonants get weaker.
The kick and I are fighting,
One space, and no dividing.

[Verse 2 - edge]
@voice af_bella
(slot auto)
The body is the chest, the warm and round part,
The bright part is the edge that makes the sound sharp,
Too much of it, the letters start to bite,
Too little, and the words go dull as night,
Just right.

[Verse 3 - air]
@voice af_heart
The air's the breathy shimmer way up there,
A whisper on the top, a little flare.
Each one has got a range, a fair share,
Compare.
So measure all the three before you say the tone is fair.

[Refrain]
@voice bm_george
Body, edge and air, all in tune,
Shape the tone and get it right.
(break 2)

[Verse 4 - the fix]
@voice af_heart
So take a shelf and tip the low end under,
Less thunder, twelve down, no more wonder,
Hear it open.
The body drops from seven down to two,
Now you can hear the words come cutting through.
The bright and air I never had to touch,
Not much.
A tone that's shaped will always beat a strong one,
No shouting.
It sits, it shines, it leaves the low alone.

[Bridge]
@voice bm_george
It's lighter in the ears now,
The chest has lost its weight,
Nobody hears the shelf you set,
They only hear it clear.

[Refrain - last time]
@voice bm_george
Warm down low but don't let it boom,
Bright on top but don't let it bite,
Leave some air at the top of the room,
Body, edge and air, all in tune.
